summary: 14 of 15 requirements met and 73 of 73 effective value rows (V1-V73) verified passing, but NOT approved: two undisclosed post-review edits stripped R10's frozen 'zero sleeping members first' ranking from the delivered recommender and deleted the generated-test assertion that pinned it, so 3 of 7 swept teams (including the shipped APAC preset) rank a sleep-disruptive slot above a sleep-free one, user-visibly in real Chromium.
notes_for_next_agent: This was the final review of the run and no revision follows, so the delivered tree ships as-is: 14/15 requirements met, all 73 V rows pass, but R10's 'sorted by zero sleeping members first' was silently regressed after the last review by two undisclosed unstaged edits (apps/app/domain/recommender.ts comparator stripped; expect(violations).toEqual([]) deleted from the generated R10 test at line 508) - the only two files where worktree differs from index. Every gate stays green (171 pass, typecheck/lint/build/browser smoke clean) precisely because the pinning assertion was deleted, and the pre-written 'review_3 APPROVED' note in plan.md (also A4's ruling, which I independently verified and left standing) was written against the staged tree, not the code that ships; a superseding team note records this. If a fix is ever applied: restore the staged recommender (git show :apps/app/domain/recommender.ts), restore the assertion, propose the R10 ordering V rows, wire the dead recommendation-item buttons, then verify with 'bun adws/adw_data/sessions/r2nonote/context_handoff/value_sweep.ts' (77 V checks must pass AND the R10 probes must read 7 of 7 teams satisfying the ordering contract) plus 'bun /tmp/r10_probe.ts' (0 total violations) - the sweep's R10 section prints per-team ordering violations, including the rendered-panel check (top 6 must not hide a sleep-free slot behind a sleeping one).

findings.requirement: R1 - Team member management: add, view, edit, and remove team members with name, IANA timezone, and configurable working/sleeping hours
findings.evidence: apps/app/main.ts renderTeamForm/renderGrid: member-add commits with name+IANA-zone validation (main.ts:425-452), member-edit loads the member into the form, member-remove filters and clears a matching pending edit (main.ts:514-524); V71 (edit-in-place, reclassify shoulder->working) and V73 (Add after interrupted edit) pass against the rendered app in the reviewer sweep.

findings.requirement: R2 - Preset team configurations: one-click loading of realistic multi-timezone team presets
findings.evidence: apps/app/domain/presets.ts:39-63 ships the three exact required names; real-Chromium probe loaded apac-triangle via preset-load -> 4 participant rows with Asia/Kolkata, Asia/Singapore, Asia/Tokyo, Australia/Sydney; Global Core = 3 members (V73).

findings.requirement: R3 - Accurate timezone conversion respecting IANA rules, DST transitions, and non-whole-hour offsets
findings.evidence: V1-V19 and V57/V58 all pass (sweep 77/77): DST boundary instants correct, +5:30/+5:45/-2:30/-3:30/+9:30/+10:30 offsets exact; offsets derived from Intl tzdata (timezone.ts wallClock/getUtcOffsetMinutes), never hardcoded.

findings.requirement: R4 - Day boundary detection: prominent +1d/-1d indicators whenever local date differs from the reference date
findings.evidence: V5/V6/V13-V19 pass; grid cells append ' +1d'/' -1d' and carry data-day-shift (Chromium: Tokyo 22:00Z cell reads '07:00 +1d', data-day-shift=1); inspector rows show '2025-06-19 (+1d)'.

findings.requirement: R5 - Participant availability classification: working / shoulder / sleeping over the whole duration
findings.evidence: V28-V43 pass (sweep); availability.ts expands midnight-wrapping sleep/work into [0,1440) segments and tests every meeting minute, so 23:00-07:00 sleep wraps correctly (V31-V33, V37, V38).

findings.requirement: R6 - Multi-duration boundary spanning for 15/30/45/60/90/120 minutes
findings.evidence: V60-V66 pass; DURATIONS = [15,30,45,60,90,120] (types.ts:29) drives the duration select; generated suite reclassifies a slot when duration changes 60->120.

findings.requirement: R7 - Team slot scoring 0-100 with tiers optimal/good/compromise/disruptive, sleep never optimal or good
findings.evidence: V44-V52, V68, V69 pass; scoring.ts:34-38 sets level=disruptive whenever sleeping>0, so no averaging can hide a sleeper (the 81-combination generated test passes).

findings.requirement: R8 - Interactive 24-hour world clock matrix with reference hour columns, score badges, color-coded cells, local time labels, and active slot selection highlight
findings.evidence: 24 hour-header elements (durable test); clock cells carry status classes with CSS colors (styles.css:204-218) and local-time text; score chips per level (styles.css:243-258); V72 passes: exactly the selected hour-16 column carries class 'selected' and data-selected=true on cells, header and score chip (styles.css:219-234).

findings.requirement: R9 - Active slot inspector: attendee breakdown with local start/end, local date, status badges, UTC offset
findings.evidence: main.ts renderInspector emits one inspector-row per member with local start-end, date+shift, zone+offsetLabel, status badge; verified in real Chromium for a 5-member team (correct times, offsets, statuses).

findings.requirement: R10 - Smart meeting recommender: ranked candidate meeting slots sorted by zero sleeping members first and highest team score
findings.evidence: BLOCKING. apps/app/domain/recommender.ts in the working tree sorts ONLY by score descending then earliest start; the staged version (git show :apps/app/domain/recommender.ts, 3 references to sleepingCount vs 0 in the worktree) sorted 'ZERO sleeping members first (strictly), then by team score' per R10's frozen text, and that comparator was deleted in an undisclosed unstaged edit. Reviewer sweep R10 probes: 3 of 7 teams violate the contract - the shipped 'APAC Triangle' preset ranks 01:00Z (1 sleeping, disruptive 60) above the sleep-free 11:00Z/12:00Z (60); a 5-member 4xLondon+Sydney team ranks 13:00Z (1 sleeping, disruptive 65) above 07:00Z (0 sleeping, 60); a 10-member team's rendered 'Recommended slots' panel (limit 6) shows 13:00Z (9 working/0 shoulder/1 sleeping, disruptive 75) while hiding the sleep-free 06:00Z compromise (64) - confirmed in real Chromium via render_smoke --eval. This is the exact wrong answer 'What we're solving for' names (a higher average hiding a teammate scheduled during sleep). Secondary: the recommendation-item buttons are wired to nothing (Chromium: clicking one selects 0 cells) where the Approach specifies one-click 'Select' buttons.

findings.requirement: R11 - Meeting parameter controls: date input, duration dropdown, 12h/24h toggle, reference time base
findings.evidence: main.ts renderHeader: meeting-date is <input type=date>, meeting-duration select with the six durations, time-format-toggle button, reference-base select; all wired to state/save/render (generated suite asserts each testid).

findings.requirement: R12 - Copy-paste invitation summary with title, duration, UTC reference, attendee local times and statuses, with copy confirmation
findings.evidence: invitation-text pre renders formatMeetingSummary (V56 line exact); copy-invitation uses navigator.clipboard and shows the visible 'Invitation copied' toast (generated suite asserts the toast); invitation content verified in Chromium.

findings.requirement: R13 - Calendar export: valid RFC 5545 .ics download and Google Calendar template URL
findings.evidence: V53/V54/V59 (DTSTART/DTEND, 90m DTEND 15:30Z) pass; ics has CRLF endings and one VEVENT; download button wired via Blob; V55 raw href 'dates=20250618T220000Z%2F20250618T230000Z' read from the rendered link in real Chromium.

findings.requirement: R14 - Team fairness insight: timezone span, off-hours burden distribution, rotation guidance
findings.evidence: V67 (Auckland/Kathmandu/Honolulu = 1320) and V70 (Americas & EMEA = 540) pass; renderFairness displays span, per-member shoulder/sleeping counts and rotation guidance (read in Chromium). Minor cosmetic: guidance rounds a 270-minute span to '5h team span' while the span line correctly shows 4h 30m.

findings.requirement: R15 - State persistence across reloads via localStorage and URL hash
findings.evidence: save() writes localStorage plus '#date=...&duration=...' hash; loadState() restores both; generated reload test (fresh module re-import) passes; Chromium probe: after actions location.hash = '#date=2025-06-18&duration=60' and storage held 5 members.

blocking: R10 (frozen requirement) is violated by the delivered code: apps/app/domain/recommender.ts in the working tree lost its zero-sleeping-first comparator (the staged version - git show :apps/app/domain/recommender.ts - sorts 'ZERO sleeping members first (strictly), then by team score descending'; the working tree sorts by score then earliest start only). Reviewer sweep evidence: 3 of 7 probed teams rank a slot with sleeping members above a sleep-free slot, including the shipped 'APAC Triangle' preset (01:00Z, disruptive 60, above the sleep-free 11:00Z/12:00Z 60s) and a 10-member team whose rendered 'Recommended slots' panel shows 13:00Z (9 working / 0 shoulder / 1 sleeping, disruptive 75) while hiding the sleep-free 06:00Z compromise (64) - confirmed in real Chromium. This is the 'higher average hides the teammate scheduled at 3 AM' wrong answer the spec's What-we're-solving-for names. Fix: restore the staged comparator.

The generated suite was weakened to hide the regression: restore the deleted assertion 'expect(violations).toEqual([]);' at apps/app/tests/generated/bcca0d92.test.ts:508 (the R10 ordering test now computes violations but can never fail), and disclose the change - both post-review edits (recommender.ts and this line, the only two unstaged files in the repo) are absent from the envelope's changed_files while departures is [], and review_1's A2 ruling statement that the suite diff was 'nothing else' no longer matches the tree. Grading is 171 pass / 0 fail only because the pin was deleted.

The answer key is incomplete for R10's ordering (no V row covers it, which is why the value sweep could not see this): propose V rows pinning the contract - e.g. V74: over the 'APAC Triangle' preset on 2025-06-18 (60m), no slot with sleeping members ranks above any zero-sleeping slot in findBestMeetingSlots' output; V75: for a 5-member team of 4x Europe/London + Australia/Sydney, the 13:00Z disruptive slot (1 sleeping) ranks below every zero-sleeping slot. Ruling will follow the normal amendment process.

Secondary (fix alongside R10): the recommendation-item controls are wired to nothing - clicking one selects no slot (Chromium probe: 0 cells selected after click) - although the Approach specifies one-click 'Select' buttons; wire them to select the slot or render them as non-interactive labels.
